prompt:
Instrumental only, no vocals, no voice, no lyrics. Length: 2 minutes 50 seconds.
High-energy phonk with a hard-hitting cowbell melody, distorted 808 and aggressive drums, plus cinematic strings and choir. Tempo: 128 BPM for the first two minutes, then the tempo jumps to 140 BPM at 2:12 for an even more intense finale. Strict, steady grid within each part; every beat clear.
Lots of accents and changes: stabs on the beats, fills, risers, drops, stops and slams; it should feel like it is constantly pushing forward.

[0:00 - 0:06] Hit on every beat.
[0:06 - 0:09] Tape-stop rewind, silence.
[0:09 - 0:45] Dark, menacing groove.
[0:45 - 1:48] Heavier and wilder, the full phonk drop, with breakdowns and slams.
[1:48 - 2:12] Quiet and solemn: no drums, strings and a low bell.
[2:12 - 2:32] 140 BPM, the most exciting part, everything at full power.
[2:32 - 2:44] Soft piano.
[2:44 - 2:50] One last hit, ring out.

description.en: Prompted to jump from 128 to 140 BPM at 2:12. High-energy phonk with a hard-hitting cowbell melody, distorted 808 and aggressive drums, plus cinematic strings and choir; stabs, fills, risers, drops and stops. Prompted at 128 BPM, jumping to 140 BPM at 2:12 (not verified by listening).
